verified_facts.text: The hotel's rooms and suites are arranged over the top floors of the One Shenzhen Bay Office Building, with views over the city and bay.
verified_facts.excerpt: Arranged over the top floors of the prestigious One Shenzhen Bay Office Building, our rooms & suites are the most spacious in Shenzhen, with spectacular views over the city and bay.

verified_facts.text: The hotel is in Nanshan District, a short distance from Qianhai.
verified_facts.excerpt: Located in Nanshan District, Raffles Shenzhen is a short distance from Qianhai, an area brimming with innovation and creativity.

verified_facts.text: The hotel is within walking distance of the Shenzhen Bay Port.

verified_facts.text: Shenzhen Bao'an International Airport is around 40 minutes' drive from the hotel.

verified_facts.text: Yun Jing restaurant is on the 70th floor of the 72-storey tower.
